text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This whole Book of Secrets thing and the
clues
that supposedly lead to Eden are a
complete
mystery.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They could just be someone's way of
getting Gold
Ship motivated for races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Whatever the case, they're doing a great
job of
getting her revved up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time to train for the next race.
choice_data_list: （今はこの流れに乗ってみよう！）
choice_data_list_en: (Let's just ride this wave for now!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...But Gold Ship isn't at the track. Looks
like I
have to go on another wild goose
chase for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I walk all over the academy, eventually
ending up
on the roof of the school
building.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's strange. We've had plenty of heated
clashes
before...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
But I'm more irked today than ever,
Nakayama...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: A little voice in my head is telling me I have to beat you no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That I'll never find Eden if I don't surpass
you first!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh. I don't know what this "Eden" crap
is about,
but you've got my attention.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You want a challenge? Bring it on. The
fiercer,
the better.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Good, then let's strike while the iron's
hot and get
started right away!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Perfect timing, Trainer! You can be our
witness!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The race is on! Try to keep up with my

afterimages, slowpoke!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two challengers take off, leaving me
to race
after them as fast as my legs will
carry me.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Let's start things out spicy! A classic
battle of who
can take the heat. Bring
out the goods, El!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Order up!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Two special sandwiches dripping with
habanero
chili sauce! They're extra
picante, just as
requested!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hold up, this "sandwich" is completely
red... It
looks like murder on toast!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, it wouldn't be much of a challenge

otherwise, would it? Now come on! Let's
do this!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ngh! This is no joke! My mouth is on fire!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Cough! But I finished the whole thing, so there! Cough!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! You both finished without a
crumb left on
your plates! I call this a
draw!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I feel like my face is melting off... But
we're not
done yet! Ryan! You're up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing. Let's get some gains in! Your

challenge is to do a hundred sit-ups in
one
minute! Let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
A hundred sit-ups in a minute? Haha!
You're on!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... What kind of unhinged challenges even are these?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... You keep complaining, but we both pulled it off... Wheeeze!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Nicely done! That was exactly a hundred
sit-ups!
It's a tie!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...It's packed here. You've really upped
the scale
of whatever this contest is.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Our statue skills are gonna
put the pro
mall mannequins to shame!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Our what?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right, Bamboo! Live up to your title
as head of
the discipline committee and
keep an eye on us
all disciplinary-like!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You can count on me! My eyes are
peeled for any
stray movements! Ready?
Begin!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hey, are we seriously doing this?

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text: Mommy? What are those two doing?

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text: Shh! It's rude to stare!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Hey, aren't they from the academy?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Huh, they are. What're they doing? So
weird...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Augh!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Dammit, this is ridiculous! Why do I
gotta put
up with this humiliation
anyway?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh, you moved. Sorry, Nakayama,
but you're
out!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Aww, yeah! I win, I win! Victory is mine!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You got me, Golshi! You dragged me
right into
your court.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But ridiculous as your challenges were, a
win's a
win! I'm not so petty as to argue
that.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'll tell you one thing, though—next time
we clash,
it's gonna be on my turf, and
I'm gonna crush you!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You can try! Tell you what, I'll keep my
fists
warmed up till then!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship vs. Nakayama Festa: victory!
(To be
continued...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, the day-long Golshi
Gauntlet
finally draws to a close.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whew, I'm burned clean outta energy.
I'm so
burnt out, I'm practically charred
carbon, like pot
stickers left on a hot
stove overnight.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: That said, I beat the Nakayama. Surely that's good enough. Maybe I can even reach Eden now...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it, she's brought
up Eden
quite a few times today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For someone who clean forgot about it
before,
it's curious she's so gung ho all
of a sudden.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What's with the staring, huh? You that
shocked
by how focused I can be when I
got my eye on the
prize?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Guess I should let the cat outta the
bag... But this
information's for your ears
only, okay?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I've been having some weird dreams
recently.
Dreams where a mysterious
voice tells me to go
to Eden and stuff.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What's really throwing me for a loop is
how
nostalgic the voice makes me feel...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It feels familiar like McQueen, but not as
proper.
It's more casual, like Nakayama...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I know that voice like I know—well, almost like I know the smell of my gramps's tatami flooring.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I expected to get another outlandish tall
tale
from her, but what she tells me is
shockingly
believable!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All the same, the Book of Secrets is the
thing that
started this whole quest for
Eden.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Is it possible whoever wrote it can also
make
themselves appear in her dreams?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Anyhoo, I'm gonna head back. I'm gonna
go at a
light all-out sprint, so try to
keep up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I chase after Gold Ship, an odd feeling
settling
heavily in my chest.
